lines.text: Job says the arrows of the Almighty have pierced him and his spirit drinks in their poison.
Job says his brothers are as faithless as wadis, which vanish from their channels in the heat.
Job says the caravans of Moab look for water, and the travelers of Sheba hope to find it.
Job asks if he is the sea that God must keep under guard, and says God frightens him with dreams.
Job asks why God has made him His messenger, so that he is a burden to God.
